coverage.why: Every accounting area except industry_lens carries 'dropped' for a number in the analyst's own words, and the financial profitability, efficiency and liquidity sections were dropped the same way.

calibration.why: Only the industry_lens verdict survived, and it matches its two anomalies; the other accounting anomalies, including both high-severity tariff-refund items, sit under areas with no verdict to calibrate against.

valuation_reading.why: market.missing, implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing and valuation.missing leave no price position, implied growth or sensitivity grid.
